title: A common strictly standard exponent for finitely many smooth free opens
statement: Let R→C be a finitely presented map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let ι be a finite type and x:ι→C. Assume each C_(x_i) is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], with free module Ω_(C_(x_i)/R) of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. There is c≥1 such that every x_i^c is strictly standard over R [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element].

source.place: Lemma 07EZ(e) and proof of Lemma 07FE, common exponent

proof.text: For each x_i, finite presentation makes the localized module of differentials finite. Its free basis is thus finite, also for a zero localization. Add a rank-zero free summand to express stable freeness. Apply the mathematically correct statement of Stacks 07EZ(e) to obtain a positive threshold e_i for all larger powers. The existing Lean record of that node needs the product parentheses repaired before it can be applied.
Take c=1+Σ_i e_i. Every threshold is at most c, so all x_i^c are strictly standard. The empty family gives c=1.
